description: Use the schema + LLM to propose values for a tool call's missing required args.

context.description: Natural-language context the user gave (a chat message, prompt, etc.).

max_fields.description: Cap on how many missing required fields to elicit in one call.

partial_args.description: Args already known. Missing required fields will be elicited.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature for elicitation. Low by default for determinism.

name: elicit_missing_args

filled.description: Elicited values keyed by field name. `null` when LLM declined/unavailable.

missing.description: Required fields that were still missing after elicitation (filled[k] === null).

proposed_args.description: partial_args merged with non-null filled, validated against the tool schema.

source.description: 'llm' if the model answered, 'offline' if no LLM, 'none-needed' if nothing missing.

title: Elicit missing tool args
